editorial:
When your son goes missing after coming home from war, you do whatever it takes to find the truth. That is the heart of this slow-burn mystery. A retired military police officer and his wife team up with a local detective to figure out what happened to their son after he returned from Iraq. The story pulls you in with quiet tension and real emotion, never rushing to give you easy answers.

Tommy Lee Jones gives a powerful, understated performance that carries the whole film. The pacing is slow and deliberate, which works well for the mystery but might test your patience if you want fast action. The supporting cast is strong, and the film asks hard questions about war and its cost. If you enjoy thoughtful crime dramas with emotional weight, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: The final twist reveals that Mike was killed by his own fellow soldiers after a fight. Hank discovers the truth and, in the last scene, raises the American flag upside down at the local school, a distress signal showing his heartbreak and protest.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves thoughtful crime dramas with emotional weight.
